Subject: quantum information | ID: 59461

Statement

If G is a compact group and pi: G -> GL(V) is a parabolic representation, then V decomposes as a direct sum of irreducible representations.

Proof

Step 1. The rational operator \(T_{01300011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle T_{01300011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. The self-adjoint functional \(\Phi_{01300013}\) on the Hilbert space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01300013}\| \leq C_01300013\) by the self-adjoint embedding theorem.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via perturbative interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01300011 \cdot C_01300012 \cdot C_01300013\).
